profile.name: 旋转编码器
profile.description: 用于检测车轮或旋转轴脉冲计数的传感器，可根据计数与时间间隔估算速度、行驶距离和里程，常用于移动机器人或小车实验中的运动反馈与里程计测量。
profile.description_en: A sensor that counts pulses from a wheel or rotating shaft and uses tick counts over time to estimate speed, traveled distance, and odometry for motion feedback in mobile robot or small vehicle experiments.
